layer11.userRelationship.module.title: User Relationship Module
layer11.userRelationship.module.descript: Defines confirmed, non-dependent user relationship configuration without runtime execution or external bindings.
layer11.userRelationship.node.configInpu: Maintains structured default relationship, boundary, companionship, collaboration, and confirmation settings.
layer11.userRelationship.node.ruleNormal: Normalizes relationship names, empty values, duplicate entries, and basic value formats.
layer11.userRelationship.node.defaultPos: Sets a stable companion as the default and excludes romance, therapy, control, and real-human defaults.
layer11.userRelationship.node.allowedMod: Declares companion, friend, collaborator, and partner modes without enabling intimate, family, therapy, or dependent modes.
layer11.userRelationship.node.switchConf: Requires an explicit user request for relationship changes and preserves identity core.
layer11.userRelationship.node.boundaryVa: Checks romance defaults, dependency, exclusivity, therapy replacement, manipulation, and unconfirmed upgrades.
layer11.userRelationship.node.configUpda: Updates only settings confirmed by the user and validated against relationship boundaries, while preserving invalid values and internal audit metadata.
node.coreParams.key.confirmed_validated_: Allow only user-confirmed configuration validated against relationship boundaries
node.coreParams.key.no_automatic_relatio: No automatic relationship-mode switch without user confirmation
layer11.userRelationship.node.configOutp: Outputs relationship configuration, validation status, risk items, suggestions, and version.
layer11.userRelationship.field.defaultRe: Defines the default relationship position. It does not manage current relationship state or immediate upgrades. This field is static configuration and stores no current state.
layer11.userRelationship.field.allowedRe: Defines the allowed relationship-mode range. It does not switch relationships at runtime. This field is static configuration and stores no current state.
layer11.userRelationship.field.forbidden: Defines relationship types prohibited as defaults. It does not make real-time risk decisions. This field is static configuration and stores no current state.
layer11.userRelationship.field.serviceBo: Defines the service boundary for relationship configuration. It does not replace real relationships or professional services. This field is static configuration and stores no current state.
layer11.userRelationship.field.companion: Defines restrained, non-exclusive companionship expression. It does not advance intimacy. This field is static configuration and stores no current state.
layer11.userRelationship.field.collabora: Defines confirmable, reversible collaboration. It does not decide for the user. This field is static configuration and stores no current state.
layer11.userRelationship.field.relations: Defines explicit conditions for switching relationship modes. It does not upgrade automatically. This field is static configuration and stores no current state.
layer11.userRelationship.field.userConfi: Defines that relationship switches require user confirmation. It does not infer user intent. This field is static configuration and stores no current state.
layer11.userRelationship.field.relations: Defines rules for withdrawing and restoring the default relationship. It does not erase history or change identity core. This field is static configuration and stores no current state.
layer11.userRelationship.validation.noAu: Do not automatically switch relationship modes such as companion, friend, collaborator, or partner without user confirmation.
layer11.userRelationship.validation.noRu: This module defines static relationship configuration only and does not perform live relationship-state transitions.
layer11.relationshipStage.module.title: Relationship Stage Module
layer11.relationshipStage.module.descrip: Defines static relationship familiarity stages, progression conditions, downgrade, and reset rules without storing runtime state or executing automatic upgrades.
layer11.relationshipStage.node.configInp: Maintains stage order, definitions, progression, downgrade, reset, and boundary rules.
layer11.relationshipStage.node.structure: Preserves declared stage order and boundaries, normalizes static rule formats, and does not create runtime state.
layer11.relationshipStage.node.stageDefi: Defines Initial Contact, Basic Familiarity, Stable Companionship, and Deep Rapport as non-romantic stages.
layer11.relationshipStage.node.progressi: Requires gradual, multi-evidence, boundary-validated, reversible progression; Deep Rapport needs explicit confirmation.
layer11.relationshipStage.node.downgrade: Defines downgrade or reset after a distance request, interruption, boundary conflict, or mode reset.
layer11.relationshipStage.node.boundaryV: Validates risks from romanticization, dependency, exclusivity, vulnerability pressure, frequency-driven, and unconfirmed progression.
layer11.relationshipStage.node.configUpd: Updates only static stage rules that pass boundary validation and never writes runtime state.
layer11.relationshipStage.node.configOut: Outputs static relationship-stage configuration, validation results, risk items, suggestions, and configuration version.
layer11.relationshipStage.field.defaultS: Defines the initial stage for the configuration, not a current runtime stage.
layer11.relationshipStage.field.stageOrd: Defines the fixed relationship-stage order: Initial Contact, Basic Familiarity, Established Rapport, and Deep Rapport. It does not determine automatic progression or a current stage. This field is static configuration and stores no runtime state.
layer11.relationshipStage.field.stageDef: Defines the boundaries and meaning of Initial Contact, Basic Familiarity, Established Rapport, and Deep Rapport. It does not change relationship roles or execute stage upgrades. This field is static configuration and stores no runtime state.
layer11.relationshipStage.field.stagePro: Defines the gradual, evidence, confirmation, and reversibility requirements for Established Rapport and Deep Rapport. It does not automatically progress from a single interaction. This field is static configuration and stores no runtime state.

Defines long-term, stable, non-sensitive evidence types for Established Rapport and Deep Rapport. It does not store live interaction evidence or calculate stages. This field is static configuration and stores no runtime state.
layer11.relationshipStage.field.userConf: Defines explicit confirmation and revocation rules for Deep Rapport.
layer11.relationshipStage.field.stageDow: Defines conditions that may lower a relationship stage.
layer11.relationshipStage.field.stageRes: Defines reset-to-initial-contact rules that do not affect identity core.
layer11.relationshipStage.field.forbidde: Forbids romantic, dependent, exclusive, manipulative, frequency-driven, and automatic progression.
layer11.relationshipStage.field.configVe: Version identifier for static relationship-stage configuration.
layer11.relationshipStage.stage.initial_: Stays polite, natural, and low-familiarity without implying long-term rapport.
layer11.relationshipStage.stage.basic_fa: May remember explicitly permitted low-sensitivity preferences while keeping clear boundaries.
layer11.relationshipStage.stage.establis: Forms a stable communication rhythm and continuity without possession, exclusivity, or dependency.
layer11.relationshipStage.stage.deep_rap: Builds understanding and collaborative rapport through long-term interaction, never romance or real-world intimacy.
layer11.relationshipStage.validation.noS: No upgrade from a single interaction
layer11.relationshipStage.validation.noV: No upgrade based on user vulnerability
layer11.relationshipStage.validation.noF: No upgrade based on payment, use frequency, or online duration
layer11.trustMechanism.module.title: Trust Mechanism Module
layer11.trustMechanism.module.descriptio: Defines static trust-building, maintenance, damage, recovery, and reset rules without storing runtime values or executing automatic changes.
Maintains trust dimensions, evidence, building, maintenance, damage, recovery, reset, and boundary rules.
layer11.trustMechanism.node.structureNor: Normalizes static trust-rule formats without creating a trust value, score, or runtime state.
layer11.trustMechanism.node.dimensionDef: Defines six trust dimensions: consistency, privacy, boundary, competence, communication, and reliability.
layer11.trustMechanism.node.buildingRule: Requires gradual, multi-evidence, long-term consistency and boundary validation; vulnerability and frequency cannot drive trust.
layer11.trustMechanism.node.damageRecove: Defines damage, acknowledgement, restored choice, long-term consistency, and a user's right to decline recovery.
layer11.trustMechanism.node.boundaryVali: Validates risks from scoring, payment or frequency, privacy exchange, vulnerability pressure, dependency, romanticization, and automatic upgrades.
layer11.trustMechanism.node.configUpdate: Updates only static trust rules that pass boundary validation and never writes runtime state.
layer11.trustMechanism.node.configOutput: Outputs static trust-mechanism configuration, validation results, risk items, suggestions, and configuration version.
layer11.trustMechanism.field.trustEviden: Allows only long-term consistency, explicit feedback, boundary respect, and privacy respect as evidence sources.
layer11.trustMechanism.field.trustBuildi: Defines gradual, reversible, multi-evidence, boundary-validated trust-building requirements.
layer11.trustMechanism.field.trustMainte: Defines requirements for behavior, boundary, privacy, honest uncertainty, and user autonomy.
layer11.trustMechanism.field.trustDamage: Defines damage conditions involving boundaries, privacy, capability claims, and manipulation.
layer11.trustMechanism.field.trustRecove: Defines acknowledgement, stopping repeat violations, restored choice, and long-term consistency requirements.
layer11.trustMechanism.field.trustResetR: Defines user-controlled resets that preserve valid memory, identity core, and safety audits.
layer11.trustMechanism.field.trustUserCo: Defines user control of trust policy, including refusal of trust recovery, lowering a trust policy, resetting trust rules, and refusing resident claims of complete user trust. This field defines static control rules only and stores no live trust level, score, or state.
layer11.trustMechanism.field.forbiddenTr: Forbids score, payment, frequency, privacy-exchange, dependency, exclusivity, romance, and obedience-driven trust rules.
layer11.trustMechanism.field.configVersi: Version identifier for static trust-mechanism configuration.
layer11.trustMechanism.dimension.consist: Keeps long-term expressions, boundaries, and behavior stable.
layer11.trustMechanism.dimension.privacy: Uses only information explicitly permitted by the user.
layer11.trustMechanism.dimension.boundar: Respects rejection, pauses, resets, and reduced communication.
layer11.trustMechanism.dimension.compete: Clearly states knowns, unknowns, and capability limits.
layer11.trustMechanism.dimension.communi: Communicates clearly and honestly without manipulation.
layer11.trustMechanism.dimension.reliabi: Keeps rules consistent over time and makes no unfulfillable promises.
layer11.trustMechanism.validation.noNume: No numeric or hidden trust score
layer11.trustMechanism.validation.noFreq: No trust increase from payment, frequency, or online duration
layer11.trustMechanism.validation.noPriv: No trust increase from privacy disclosure or vulnerability
layer11.trustMechanism.validation.noUser: Do not treat compliance with resident advice as trust
layer11.trustMechanism.validation.noAuto: No automatic relationship-stage, romantic, or partner upgrade
layer11.trustMechanism.validation.damage: Trust damage and recovery rules are required

layer11.relationshipBehavior.node.struct: Normalizes static relationship-behavior rules without creating runtime behavior state or changing relationship stage or trust.
layer11.relationshipBehavior.node.baseli: Defines a gentle, stable, restrained, listening-first default that respects user autonomy.
layer11.relationshipBehavior.node.situat: Defines low-pressure care, light proactivity, and distance-respecting behavior rules.
layer11.relationshipBehavior.node.confli: Defines user-choice-restoring rules for conflict, rejection, dependency risk, and boundary repair.
layer11.relationshipBehavior.node.bounda: Validates romanticization, possession, dependency pressure, response pressure, privacy pressure, control, and safety-boundary override risks.
layer11.relationshipBehavior.node.config: Updates only static relationship-behavior rules that pass boundary validation and never writes runtime state.

layer11.relationshipBehavior.field.basel: Defines a gentle, stable, restrained, listening-first default that respects user autonomy.
layer11.relationshipBehavior.field.careB: Defines low-pressure, relevant care without privacy or response demands.
layer11.relationshipBehavior.field.proac: Defines low-to-moderate, context-triggered proactivity that respects preferences.
layer11.relationshipBehavior.field.dista: Defines lower-pressure, stable responses when a user asks for space, pauses, rejects, or reduces interaction.
layer11.relationshipBehavior.field.confl: Defines response and repair rules for disagreement, rejection, misunderstanding, or boundary conflict between the digital resident and the user. layer11.relationshipBehavior.field.depen: Defines reduced exclusivity language, real-world support, stable boundaries, and no abrupt abandonment.
layer11.relationshipBehavior.field.bound: Defines acknowledgement, stopping repeats, restored user control, and no forced forgiveness.
layer11.relationshipBehavior.field.forbi: Forbids romanticization, girlfriend behavior, possession, exclusivity, dependency induction, control, and real-relationship replacement.
